title: Adult Mouse Ear Dissociation Protocol on Ice
author: Andrew Potter
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ucwesxe
materials: Dissect out ear tissue and place in ice-cold hypothermosol on ice.
Examine using hemocytometer with trypan blue.

steps.title: Transfer and mince ear tissue
steps.instruction: Using forceps, transfer ear tissue to a petri dish on ice, then mince thoroughly on ice for 3–4 min into ~1 mm³ pieces with a razor blade, employing a grinding motion and vigorous breaking while manipulating with forceps.

steps.title: Add enzyme cocktail
steps.instruction: Place 23 mg of the minced tissue into 1 mL B. Lich enzyme cocktail and incubate on ice.

steps.title: Shake and triturate digest
steps.instruction: While on ice, shake the tube every minute and triturate with a P1000 pipette (tip cut) every 2 min, starting at minute 2, performing 10 triturations each time, for a total digestion time of 20 min.

substeps.instruction: At minute 2, begin triturating 10× with the cut‑tip P1000; repeat every 2 min.

steps.title: First dounce homogenization
steps.instruction: After 20 min, transfer the digest to a 2 mL dounce homogenizer and perform 10 strokes with Pestle A every 2 min for 4 cycles (total 8 min) until the mixture becomes turbid.

substeps.instruction: Perform 10 strokes of Pestle A, wait 2 min; repeat 4 times.

steps.title: Settle and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: At 28 min total digest time, let tissue chunks settle in the dounce for 2 min, then use a 1 mL serological pipet to transfer 90 % of the supernatant onto a 30 µm filter placed in a 15 mL conical tube.

steps.title: Rinse filter and keep first layer
steps.instruction: Rinse the filter with 5 mL ice‑cold PBS/BSA 0.04 %, keep the flow‑through (released cells) on ice, and retain the filter with tissue for a second digestion layer.

steps.title: Second enzyme addition
steps.instruction: Add an additional 1 mL B. Lich enzyme mix to the residual tissue chunks remaining in the dounce homogenizer and continue incubating on ice.

steps.title: Second dounce homogenization
steps.instruction: Perform 10 strokes of Pestle A every 2 min for 15 min (total digest time now 45 min).

substeps.instruction: Every 2 min, execute 10 strokes; repeat for 15 min.

steps.title: Final filtration and rinse
steps.instruction: Transfer the entire volume to the same 30 µm filter in the 15 mL conical tube and rinse with an additional 5 mL ice‑cold PBS/BSA 0.04 %.

steps.title: Centrifuge cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filtered cells at 300 g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend cell pellet
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 100 µL ice‑cold PBS/BSA 0.04 % (still in the 15 mL conical).

steps.title: RBC lysis
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL RBC lysis buffer to the cell suspension, triturate 10 times, and let sit on ice for 2 min.

steps.title: Dilute lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Add 12 mL ice‑cold PBS/BSA 0.04 % to dilute the RBC lysis buffer.

steps.title: Second spin and resuspend
steps.instruction: Spin at 300 g for 5 min, discard supernatant, and resuspend the cells in 100–200 µL PBS/BSA 0.04 %.

steps.title: Adjust cell concentration
steps.instruction: Adjust the final cell concentration to 1,000 cells/µL for Chromium or 100 cells/µL for Drop‑Seq.
